From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>

Subject: Close→Live synchronization checklist & MAP — implementation roadmap

Alex — thanks again for the conversation this morning. Per our agreement during the call, attaching a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP_v1.xlsx) that embeds the post-signature implementation plan (rollout, canary, migration, training). High-level intent below so we have a single canonical artifact to track commitments through to live.

Key windows (proposed)
- Day 0 (Sig): 2026-01-12 — SOW countersigned (procurement to upload PO).
- Week 1–2: Provisioning + generator tuning for internal UAT (non-prod).
- Week 3: Canary 1 (limited traffic 2% / 5% progressive over 48 hours).
- Week 4: Canary 2 (expanded workload, latency verification).
- Week 5: Migration dry-run & rollback rehearsal.
- Week 6: Training for ops & product teams (recorded + live Q&A).
- Week 8: Go / No-go — full traffic cutover.

Embedded in the MAP spreadsheet: owner, SLA gating criteria, rollback triggers, training slots, and a short acceptance checklist for each canary phase. A couple of asks to keep things moving: 1) please confirm the procurement PO reference and expected invoice cadence; 2) confirm two slots for training week (proposed 2026-02-23, 2026-02-24); 3) nominate a Nimbus technical owner for migration rehearsals.

Acceptance gating examples (draft):
- Performance: p95 inference latency < 300ms on the target GA profile under canary load.
- Quality: generated output pass-rate on the smoke eval suite >= 92%.
- Reliability: error rate < 0.1% sustained across 24h window during canary.

Attachments: MAP_v1.xlsx (master plan), Ops_Questions.docx (open items).

If you want, we can convert the MAP into a shared HubSpot record (HS-1234567) so both teams can track tasks. I added Laura and Vanessa to align on delivery cadence.

— Markus
Markus Klein | Head of Customer Solutions, Redwood Inference

1) Canary cadence: shift Canary 1 to a weekday window where Nimbus can observe logs live — propose Wed, 2026-02-10, 10:00–16:00 PT. Canary 2 to follow Tue, 2026-02-16 with ramp to 20% traffic.
2) Data retention/KMS: we can support customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-KMS). Ops will need the KMS ARN and the contact for key rotation policies before Canary 1. That can be a gating item in the MAP.
3) Migration rehearsal: schedule a dry-run with a simulated traffic generator (we'll provide the script) on 2026-02-18. We recommend one full rollback rehearsal in the window so teams are comfortable with the fallback path.

Action items I own in the MAP: provisioning checklist and runbook handoff (due 2026-02-05). Laura

Looping in the ops acceptance criteria so we have a concise canary checklist in the MAP. Quoted below for visibility.

Canary acceptance checklist (must pass all):
- Latency: p95 < 300ms on production-like dataset for 24h.
- Throughput: system sustains target throughput (as per SOW profile) at 80% for 3 consecutive hours without backlog growth.
- Error surface: no new error classes introduced; 5xx spike < 0.05%.
- KV/Cache sanity: warmup completes within expected window; no cache eviction loops.
- Feature parity: model variant responses must not regress on the provided eval-set (we'll share the baseline).

If any item fails, trigger an immediate rollback to the previous variant; post-mortem within 48 hours. I'll add these rows into MAP_v1.xlsx and link the short runbook (Drive).

Vanessa Ortiz | Director, Customer Reliability, Redwood Inference

All — thanks for the quick alignment. Summary / confirmed commitments (I'll update MAP_v1.xlsx with these rows and status tags):

1) Procurement: Nimbus will upload PO NIM-PO-98234 and signed_SOW_Nimbus.pdf by Thu 2026-01-15 (procurement@nimbusanalytics.com). Finance will issue first invoice per SOW terms. (owner: procurement / due: 2026-01-15)
2) Provisioning: Redwood to complete dedicated staging cluster + initial model pin by 2026-02-05. (owner: Laura / priyom_das)
3) KMS handoff: Nimbus to provide KMS ARN and RSA contact for rotation docs by 2026-02-01. This is a hard gate for Canary 1. (owner: Nimbus / due: 2026-02-01)
4) Canary 1: 2026-02-10 — limited traffic (2% → 5% over 48h). Acceptance gating per Vanessa's checklist. (owner: Redwood ops + Nimbus eng)
5) Canary 2: 2026-02-16 — expanded traffic mapped in MAP.
6) Migration rehearsal & rollback rehearsal: 2026-02-18 (owner: priyom_das + Nimbus tech lead).
7) Training: live session 2026-02-23 2:00pm ET; recording to be shared. (owner: Redwood DX)
8) Go/no-go decision: 2026-03-01 — final cutover planned 2026-03-03 if green.

Open items: confirmation of Nimbus technical owner (Priya Shah expected), final invoice cadence (Nimbus finance), and any legal changes to data retention in the SOW.

Next step: Alex / procurement to confirm PO uploaded; Nimbus tech lead to accept calendar invites for the canary windows and rehearsal. I'll mark action items in HS-1234567 and share the Drive link (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bMAPsTeam/nimbus-map).

Thanks — excited to get you onboarded.

— Markus
